width.rule: ≤4y: walk-forward conformal P10/P90 of AR1-relative log errors; 10y/30y: Idle/Redline corridor around Cruise; fan tapers 4y→10y

method.disclaimer: P50 mean-reverts toward Cruise via AR(1) (same family as Models short-term). P10/P90 labels apply only through 4y, where walk-forward conformal coverage is real — empirical coverage targets, NOT confidence intervals (independent windows are small). Beyond 4y this is a power-law residual ribbon, not a probability. Closed-loop is inactive (2 matured ledger calls) — there is no live recalibration. 10y/30y (and the fan from 20y through 30y) use the Models Idle/Redline corridor around Cruise as a scenario ribbon only. Live ledger freezes 30d/90d/1y/2y/4y. Educational scenario, not financial advice.

horizons.label: 10 years
